tools.name: search_experiences
tools.description: Search our tours: island hopping, Maya Bay, private boats, snorkeling, diving, boat parties, cultural day trips. Covers Koh Phi Phi, Krabi (Ao Nang, Railay), Phuket, Koh Yao, Bangkok and Chiang Mai. Returns ids, starting prices, durations and page links. Tour titles are in French.

tools.name: get_experience_details
tools.description: Full live sheet of one tour: price tiers (per person or per whole boat), child price, dated price periods, duration, schedule, meeting point, what is included, national park fee, page link.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Live availability and exact party price of one tour on one date (seats left, blocked dates, 48h notice rule, dated prices). When the date is not bookable, it lists the next open dates.

tools.name: book_experience
tools.description: Creates a tour booking pending payment and returns its reference and a secure payment page on phiphiparadise.travel. Requires traveller_confirmed: true, set once the traveller has approved the tour, date, party, total and payment. Payment is online: 'full' (default) or 'deposit' when the tour offers

tools.name: search_transfers
tools.description: Boat transfers between Phuket, Krabi, Ao Nang, Railay, Koh Phi Phi, Koh Lanta, Koh Yao, Koh Lipe and the Gulf islands: departure times, operator, piers, hotel pickup policy and price per person. Suggests a connection when there is no direct boat.

tools.name: book_transfer
tools.description: Creates a booking for one ferry or speedboat departure listed by search_transfers and returns its reference and a secure payment page. Requires traveller_confirmed: true, set once the traveller has approved the route, date, time, passengers and total. Transfers are paid online in full; the seat is s

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Hotels for a destination. With check-in and check-out dates: live Agoda nightly rates, stars, guest scores and booking links. Without dates: our editorial shortlist. Destinations: koh-phi-phi, phuket, krabi, koh-yao, bangkok, chiang-mai, koh-lanta, koh-lipe, koh-samui, koh-phangan, koh-tao, khao-lak

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Flights to and within Thailand (e.g. Paris CDG to Bangkok BKK, Bangkok to Krabi KBV or Phuket HKT). Returns live fares when our search has them, plus ready-made Google Flights and Skyscanner links in every case. The traveller books flights with the airline.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Build a multi-stop Thailand itinerary (stops in travel order) and get a shareable page plus a PDF: day-by-day plan, map, transport between stops with prices, hotel picks and tours. Suited to trips of several days or several places.

tools.name: ask_travel_guides
tools.description: Search our own Thailand travel guides: how to get from A to B, last boats, weather and monsoon by month, Maya Bay rules, how many days per island, budgets, safety. Returns excerpts and links.
